blocks.text:
Swipe up on an app icon for a small panel with its **shortcuts**, **latest notifications** and **music controls**. Touch and hold an icon and choose Panel if you'd rather not swipe.

Inspired by Velox by Phillip Tennen. Re-created from scratch; no tweak code is included.

items: Works on the cover and inner screens

entries.notes: Cabinet (formerly App Panels) is now a package in the Folio Market.
